title: London-based enterprise coding startup SolveAI raised a $45M Series A led by GV in November 2025 and a $5M pre-seed led by Accel in August 2025 (Allie Garfinkle/Fortune)
summary: Allie Garfinkle / Fortune: London-based enterprise coding startup SolveAI raised a $45M Series A led by GV in November 2025 and a $5M pre-seed led by Accel in August 2025 — Senior Finance Reporter And Author Of Term Sheet — In just eight months of existence, SolveAI has raised $50 million.
